question.text: LTCG on listed REIT unit sold > 12 months Rs. 3 lakh (post Jul 2024). Tax:

explanation.text: The Logic: Treating listed REIT units like other listed equity-style securities post-July 2024, LTCG above the Rs. 1,25,000 exemption is taxed at 12.5%. So taxable LTCG = 3,00,000 - 1,25,000 = 1,75,000, and tax = 1,75,000 x 12.5% = Rs. 21,875. The Trap: "Nil" ignores the gain altogether; Rs. 30,000 and Rs. 40,000 either skip the Rs. 1.25 lakh exemption or apply an incorrect rate, so they cannot reconcile with the post-July-2024 LTCG framework on listed units. Note: The specific LTCG treatment for listed REIT units at the equity rate with the Rs. 1.25 lakh exemption was not found in the cited PMS workbook chapters on REITs and taxation. The framing above reflects general post-Finance-Act-2024 capital-gains tax knowledge for listed business-trust units rather than a direct workbook citation.
